read_scope: Exact installed resume3 owner, actual launch receipt, fixed owner/preflight files and wrapper log, selected /proc stat/io/wchan for wrapper 6603/9193748 and its exact recorded runner only. Two samples one second apart.

Actual preflight launch/source/argv and recorded wrapper/runner identities are checked before process projection.
Proc reads are bounded and start ticks are rechecked after optional io/wchan reads.
Only selected refusal/exit fields, file sizes and bounded task progress are exported.
